preconditions.description: The length of the input string is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in palindrome)
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of lowercase English letters.
The input string is a palindrome.

postconditions.description: If the input string has length 1, the function returns an empty string.

postconditions.expression: len(palindrome) > 1 and return_value != palindrome and return_value != return_value[::-1] and len(return_value) == len(palindrome) and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: If the input string has length greater than 1, the returned string has the same length, consists of lowercase letters, is not a palindrome, and differs from the input by exactly one character.

postconditions.expression: len(palindrome) > 1 and all(not (candidate != palindrome and candidate != candidate[::-1] and len(candidate) == len(palindrome) and sum(1 for i in range(len(palindrome)) if candidate[i] != palindrome[i]) == 1) or candidate >= return_value for candidate in [''.join(palindrome[:i] + chr(ord('a') if palindrome[i] != 'a' else ord('b')) + palindrome[i+1:]) for i in range(len(palindrome))])
postconditions.description: If the input string has length greater than 1, the returned string is the lexicographically smallest among all valid non-palindromic strings obtainable by changing exactly one character.
